THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Brookies & Cream Protein Creami

Brown-butter vanilla protein Creami packed with HighKey chocolate-chip mini cookies, Prime Bites brownie, crushed sandwich cookie, and Barebells Brownie Batter bar. Approximately 390 calories and 47g protein for the whole pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME24 hr freeze + 5 min rest + spin
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~390 cal | ~47g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 serving (about 15g) Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal / 14g protein)
  • 2 tbsp Whole Earth monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1/2 tsp brown butter emulsion

Ingredients — continued

  • 1 drop natural brown food coloring
  • 2 HighKey chocolate-chip protein mini cookies
  • 1/4 Prime Bites Chocolate Cookie Monster brownie (about 16g)
  • 1 HighKey chocolate sandwich cookie, crushed
  • 1/4 Barebells Brownie Batter protein bar, chopped (about 14g)

Allergens: dairy, wheat, soy.

You want a high-protein homemade remake of Crumbl's Brookies & Cream Cookie with brown butter ice cream, brownie chunks, and cookie crumbles.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND BASE. Blend milk, whey isolate, monk-fruit sweetener, guar gum, salt, brown butter emulsion and natural food coloring until completely smooth.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Freeze upright on a level surface for 24 hours.
  3. 3.REST & SPIN. Rest pint on the counter for 5 minutes, then spin on Regular Ice Cream. Run a Re-spin without added liquid if needed until creamy.
  4. 4.MIX-IN. Add 2 HighKey chocolate-chip mini cookies and 1/4 Prime Bites brownie. Process on the Mix-In setting.
  5. 5.TOP & SERVE. Scoop into a bowl, then scatter 1 crushed HighKey sandwich cookie and 1/4 chopped Barebells Brownie Batter bar on top.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun base upright and level. Spin and add toppings when ready to eat.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Follow the Creami machine guidance for storage and reprocessing.

Estimated nutrition

~390 cal | ~47g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint.
